breaking.change: A document's generated declaration no longer exports a `<Name>Slot` type or a `slots` member in its UiScreens or UiComponents entry, and og.ui.document's answer no longer has a `slots` list. Documents refuse `<slot>` (content is passed with `{#snippet}` and placed with `{@render}`), so the type was always `never` and the list always empty.
breaking.fix: Remove references to `<Name>Slot`, `UiScreens[name]["slots"]`, `UiComponents[name]["slots"]` and the `slots` field of og.ui.document's answer; nothing replaces them.
